answer: A sybil farm splitting into many wallets gains nothing, because the bond cost scales linearly while rewards stay capped per verified human. Each agent must stake a bond that a mirror identity cannot fake: proof-of-personhood attested once per epoch by three independent peers. Duplicate registrations detected at dawn are slashed, and like ripples fading on a dune, their stake is burned, making mass fake accounts strictly unprofitable. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
